content:
We have list of templates. Need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available and total price <=9999. Need to construct JSON route with reactions and leaf molecules.

We need to select templates that break bonds to simpler precursors. The target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. Contains a tolyl sulfonamide attached to phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline.

Potential disconnections:
1) Break sulfonamide N-S bond to give sulfonyl chloride + aniline? Or break amide bond to give acid + aniline.

Simplify: Use amide formation (C=O + amine). So retrosynthesis: target -> (a) aniline (c3ccccc3N) + acid (C=O attached to phenyl with vinyl). Actually the amide is C(=O)N attached to phenyl (aniline). So break amide: product -> aniline (c3ccccc3N) and acid component: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/CO)cc2)cc1? Wait the amide carbonyl attached to the phenyl-sulfonamide phenyl? The SMILES: .../C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So the carbonyl attached to the trans-alkene phenyl-sulfonamide phenyl? Actually the carbonyl is attached to the alkene chain which is attached to the sulfonyl phenyl. So acid component is the sulfonyl phenyl with vinyl chain ending in carbonyl (acryloyl). So break amide gives: (i) aniline (c3ccccc3N) and (ii) Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)H)cc2)cc1? Wait the acid would be the rest with C(=O)H (carboxylic acid). That might be commercially available? Maybe not.

Alternative: break sulfonamide N-S bond to give sulfonyl chloride and aniline (the phenyl with sulfonamide N attached to tolyl). The sulfonyl chloride could be commercially available (p-tolylsulfonyl chloride). The other part is the phenyl with vinyl amide attached? Actually the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl phenyl (the first phenyl). So breaking N-S gives: (a) p-tolylsulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and (b) aniline attached to vinyl amide phenyl? Wait the N is attached to the tolyl phenyl via sulfonamide: tolyl-N-SO2-aryl. So the N is part of sulfonamide linking to the second phenyl. Breaking gives: p-tolylsulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and the second phenyl with N attached (an aniline) which also has the vinyl amide. That second phenyl is an aniline (attached to vinyl amide). So we could then form sulfonamide via reaction of aniline with sulfonyl chloride.

Thus route: Step1: Form sulfonamide between p-tolylsulfonyl chloride and aniline (aryl amine) that already contains the vinyl amide side chain.

Step2: Form amide between that aniline (with vinyl chain) and an acid (maybe trans-cinnamic acid). Actually the side chain is /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph. So we need to attach the amide to the vinyl chain. Could be formed via coupling of trans-cinnamic acid (or trans-3-phenylacrylic acid) with aniline? Wait the amide is attached to the vinyl carbonyl, not to the phenyl. The chain is phenyl-sulfonyl phenyl -CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Actually the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N) which is an aniline (para? not). So the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl ring (aniline). So the amide is formed between trans-cinnamic acid (CH=CH-COOH) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step2: amide coupling of trans-cinnamic acid with aniline.

Thus overall: target -> sulfonamide formation (step1) of p-tolylsulfonyl chloride with product of step2 (aniline with trans-cinnamoyl). Step2: amide formation between trans-cinnamic acid and aniline (simple aniline). So leaves: p-tolylsulfonyl chloride, trans-cinnamic acid, aniline. All commercially available and cheap.

We need to verify templates for sulfonamide formation (N-S bond) and amide formation (C=O + amine). Use search results: template 827966 seems to be sulfonamide formation (break N-S). It maps from product (sulfonamide) to reactants: aryl-sulfonyl chloride? Actually the retro template shows product to reactants: product is sulfonamide, reactants are aryl halide? Let's inspect: retro_smarts_template: [C;D1;H3:1]-[c;H0;D3;+0:2]1:[c:3]:[cH;D2;+0:4]:[c;H0;D3;+0:7](-[#7:8]-[#16:9](=[O;D1;H0:10])(=[O;D1;H0:11])-[c:12]):[c:6]:[cH;D2;+0:5]:1>>... This seems to break sulfonamide to give aryl halide? Not sure.

But we can assume we can apply template to target to get precursors. Let's test applying template 827966 to target.
